# Template Preparation: CarouselRoll (ColorLib Carousel V13)

- **Source Template**: ColorLib Carousel V13 (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/carousel-13/`)
- **Assigned New Name**: `carouselroll`
- **Preview URL**: `https://colorlib.com/wp/template/carousel-13/`
- **Design Category**: Vertical Carousel & Slideshow Showcase

## Structure & Section Breakdown

1. **Navbar**: Fixed/sticky navigation with brand logo, nav items (Home, Slideshow, Features, Gallery, Contact), and CTA.
2. **Hero Section**: Bold headline, subtext, primary CTA, and introductory visual element.
3. **Vertical Carousel Showcase**: Core vertical slider component displaying featured slides, images, titles, and descriptions with vertical navigation controls.
4. **Features Grid**: Multi-column grid showcasing benefits with Lucide icons and clean cards.
5. **Call to Action / Footer**: Newsletter signup, navigation links, copyright, and mandatory Component Dock attribution link (`https://www.componentdock.com/`).

## Design Notes

- **Palette**: Clean sky blue (`#0284c7`) primary accents, slate dark text (`#0f172a`), and crisp white/slate light backgrounds.
- **Typography**: Inter sans-serif font stack.
- **Components to reuse**: `packages/ui` Button, Card, container wrappers, and Lucide icons.
